row:
Hi! Welcome to my channel!
My name is Dominic Baechler and I will be a first-year veterinary student at UC Davis, the #1 veterinary school in the country! My goal for this channel is to take you all with me on my journey through veterinary school while also providing educational videos for pre-vet and veterinary students alike. 

I plan to create informational videos for pre-vets, conduct interviews with industry professionals, and share my experiences through the rigors of veterinary school. Care to join?

IG: dom_baechler
